posts.title: Posture and Presence
posts.description: Observe the inner stillness of Yehudi Menuhin, one of the great violinists of the 20th century. Notice the majestic steadiness of his posture and his simple, gentle movements, each gesture commanding an exquisite wave of sound. Cultivate your own presence. Bring more of your inner strength and conviction. Practice this and cultivate presence. Bruser & Menuhin (1999, pp. 44–45). REFERENCES Bruser,

posts.title: Dissolving Into Sound
posts.description: Listening to Julian Lage's video on his YouTube channel, I came to realize a subtle quality: He and his quartet are in a meditative state. It doesn't look like they are performing, nor are they working. Thus, listening to them draws you into that restorative state in which you strip off the day's tension.
